metadata.note: Derived island corridor massing on the authored land apron, not survey-grade reconstruction. Original WGS84 footprints and relative roof heights; flat ground; connected-part minimum base datum and upper-envelope podium/tower silhouettes. Buildings clipped to the land boundary and 3.5m beyond the surface carriageways. Missing heights use storeys x 3.2m or 9.6m. Facades, paving and vegetation are authored; selected street centrelines come from the Transport Department; the coastline remains authored.
